title: AgentForge gates.json
description: Approval ledger for artifacts requiring human sign-off before a write is honoured or a PR is opened. Written atomically after every decision. Decided in gates-mvp.plan.md Task 1 (no formal ADR yet — see that plan's Notes).

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write.

gates.description: Keyed by artifact path (or a synthetic key for the PR gate, e.g. 'pr:<branch>').

stage.description: Stage graph id this gate belongs to (e.g. S2, S5, S6, S7, or S13 for the PR gate, key 'pr:<branch>'). Free-form string: older ledgers may still carry retired ids such as S6c or S8.

type.description: hard: blocks until approved, no bypass. soft: advisory, does not block writes. The PR gate (key 'pr:<branch>') is type 'hard' like any other — D3's warn-with-override escape hatch was reversed at S13: the PR gate is now hard/no-override like every other gate.

status.description: The ONLY one-shot mechanism (gates-mvp.plan.md Task 1 GOTCHA). stop-hitl-gate.js blocks only on 'pending'; pre-write-hitl-gate.js unblocks writes only on 'approved'. No second 'already asked' flag exists.

opened_by.description: Identity that drove the artifact to this gate (ADR-0012 US-02-03, optional, additive). Empty/absent means unknown — no self-approval check applies. When set, record_decision refuses an 'approved' outcome from this same identity (prevent-self-review).

decisions.description: Append-only audit trail. Every AskUserQuestion answer is recorded here, whatever the outcome.
